scripts.check: npm run build && cd pilot && npx hyperframes check
scripts.render:draft: npm run build && [ -f pilot/assets/bed.wav ] || npm run audio && cd pilot && npx hyperframes render --quality draft --fps 24 --variables '{"samples":3,"scale":0.5}' -o renders/pilot-draft.mp4
scripts.render:final: npm run build && [ -f pilot/assets/bed.wav ] || npm run audio && cd pilot && npx hyperframes render --quality delivery --fps 24 --variables '{"samples":12,"scale":1}' --player-ready-timeout 180000 --protocol-timeout 3600000 -o renders/pilot-1080p24.mp4
